test_asof_basic: test the DataFrame.asof method with date_range index and NaN values to verify forward-fill behavior
test_asof_subset: test the DataFrame.asof method with subset parameter to filter which columns are processed
test_asof_missing: test the DataFrame.asof method when no match is found before the earliest index date

test_asof_periodindex_mismatch: test the DataFrame.asof method raises IncompatibleFrequency when PeriodIndex frequency mismatches input
